numberedScenarioStatus.claimedTitle: 101 ways a program can be stopped/blocked/killed
numberedScenarioStatus.note: The document skips item 76. Its other numbered section headings are not counted as failure scenarios. No missing scenario was invented.

categories.label: Security and endpoint protections
categories.defensiveFocus: Code signing, trusted distribution, compatibility diagnostics and security review.

categories.label: Operating system and kernel constraints
categories.defensiveFocus: Graceful shutdown, permission-aware design, resource budgets and checkpoint recovery.

categories.label: Malicious interference and abuse
categories.defensiveFocus: Incident response, anti-abuse controls, backups and least-privilege isolation; no evasion advice.

categories.label: Software bugs and logic defects
categories.defensiveFocus: Input validation, safe error handling, tests, bounded loops and dependency controls.

categories.label: Network and infrastructure failures
categories.defensiveFocus: Offline-first behavior, timeouts, reconnect strategies and graceful degradation.

categories.label: Hardware and physical limitations
categories.defensiveFocus: Safe shutdown, power protection, storage checks, verified backups and device diagnostics.

categories.label: Human, business and licensing factors
categories.defensiveFocus: User-controlled stop, reversible migrations, documented licenses and authorized administration.

interpretation.authorProposal: A primordial root kill switch described as preceding the WWW and AI is a philosophical or proposed system abstraction in the supplied text.
interpretation.verifiedEngineeringClaim: A program can still be stopped by physical power loss, kernel/OS authority, valid user action and security controls. Basic arithmetic identities do not remove these constraints.
interpretation.scope: Build defensive resilience and auditability only; do not bypass authorized security controls, defeat administrator termination or assert invulnerability.

publication: Only audit metadata and engineering boundaries were included; the two full pasted text files are not automatically published.
